title: What Do Foundation Models for Market Microstructure Learn? A Controlled Study with Synthetic Limit Order Books
abstract: arXiv:2610.20104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive transformers trained on limit order book (LOB) message streams are increasingly proposed as foundation models for market microstructure. Because the generative process of real markets is unknown, these models can be judged only by the realism of their output, leaving open what they actually learn. We make the question answerable by inverting the setup: we train GPT-style models on order flow from simulators whose latent parameters are known, so that the Bayes-optimal predictor, the generating state, and the exact data entropy serve as references. Measured against them, next-token pretraining on order flow implements amortized Bayesian inference over market regimes. The learned predictive matches the exact Bayes optimum to within a millinat per token and approaches the oracle floor even on a nonstationary family whose latent state drifts within an episode, a regime that requires filtering. translated_title: 市场微观结构基础模型学到了什么？基于合成限价订单簿的受控研究
translated_abstract: 在限价订单簿（LOB）消息流上训练的自回归Transformer 越来越多地被提出作为市场微观结构的基础模型。由于真实市场的生成过程是未知的，这些模型只能通过其输出的真实性来评判，这使它们究竟学到了什么这一问题悬而未决。我们通过反转实验设置使这一问题变得可以回答：我们在潜在参数已知的模拟器所产生的订单流上训练GPT风格的模型，从而使得贝叶斯最优预测器、生成状态以及精确数据熵都可以作为参照基准。以此为衡量标准，订单流上的下一词元预训练实际上实现了对市场状态机制的摊销贝叶斯推断。学习到的预测器与精确贝叶斯最优解的差距不超过每词元一毫纳特，即使在潜在状态在一个回合内发生漂移的非平稳情形下，即需要滤波才能处理的机制中，也能逼近预言机下界。潜在的状态机制可被线性解码……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过在潜在参数已知的合成限价订单簿模拟器上训练GPT风格基础模型，首次证明订单流上的下一词元预训练实质上实现了对市场机制的摊销贝叶斯推断，其预测性能可精确逼近贝叶斯最优解。
en_tdlr: By training GPT-style foundation models on order flow from simulators with known latent parameters, this paper demonstrates that next-token pretraining on limit order book streams implements amortized Bayesian inference over market regimes, matching the exact Bayes optimum to within a millinat per token.
